name: AI Content Cleanup
description: AI-assisted cleanup workflows for migrated and legacy content.
project_description:
AI Content Cleanup is a Drupal content optimization and modernization module that automatically detects, cleans, and standardizes messy or outdated content across Drupal websites using AI-assisted processing and intelligent cleanup workflows.

 
The module helps organizations improve content quality, accessibility, consistency, and maintainability by automatically fixing broken HTML, removing unnecessary inline styles, normalizing heading structures, and modernizing legacy markup.

 
Designed for Drupal 10 and Drupal 11, the module provides automated cleanup operations, bulk processing tools, side-by-side content comparison, AI-powered recommendations, rollback support, and configurable cleanup rules directly within the Drupal admin interface.

 Features 
 Broken HTML Repair 
 
 Detect and repair malformed HTML 
 Fix unclosed tags 
 Normalize invalid markup structures 
 Repair deprecated HTML patterns 
 
 Inline Style Removal 
 
 Remove inline CSS styles 
 Convert styles into reusable classes 
 Reduce unnecessary markup bloat 
 Improve frontend consistency 
 
 Heading Structure Standardization 
 
 Normalize heading hierarchy 
 Fix skipped heading levels 
 Improve semantic structure 
 Enhance accessibility and SEO 
 
 Accessibility Cleanup 
 
 Detect accessibility issues 
 Add missing alt text placeholders 
 Improve semantic markup 
 Remove empty or inaccessible elements 
 
 Legacy Markup Modernization 
 
 Replace deprecated HTML tags 
 Normalize outdated formatting 
 Modernize legacy content structures 
 Improve compatibility with modern themes 
 
 AI-Assisted Recommendations 
 
 Intelligent cleanup suggestions 
 Automated issue prioritization 
 Context-aware recommendations 
 Confidence scoring for cleanup operations 
 
 Bulk Cleanup Operations 
 
 Bulk content cleanup workflows 
 Batch processing support 
 Content filtering and targeting 
 Dry-run preview mode 
 
 Content Comparison Editor 
 
 Side-by-side content comparison 
 Preview before applying changes 
 Visual diff view 
 Selective cleanup approval 
 
 Templates & Cleanup Rules 
 
 Create reusable cleanup templates 
 Configure cleanup rules 
 Content-type specific processing 
 Advanced cleanup customization 
 
 History & Rollback 
 
 Cleanup history tracking 
 Rollback previous cleanup operations 
 Operation audit logs 
 Cleanup reporting dashboard 
 
 
 Use Cases 
 Drupal Migration Cleanup 
 
Clean migrated legacy content after Drupal upgrades or platform migrations.

 Accessibility Improvements 
 
Improve semantic structure and accessibility compliance across content.

 Content Standardization 
 
Ensure consistent formatting and markup across editorial teams.

 SEO Optimization 
 
Improve semantic HTML structure and heading hierarchy for better SEO.

 Legacy Content Modernization 
 
Update outdated markup and formatting for modern Drupal themes and frontend architectures.

 
 Benefits 
 
 Improve content consistency 
 Reduce manual cleanup effort 
 Enhance accessibility compliance 
 Improve frontend rendering quality 
 Reduce markup bloat 
 Modernize legacy content 
 Simplify editorial workflows 
 Improve maintainability
